content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] with [article_no] along with two analog input modules and one analog output module. I am using a cable with a serial connection; one end is plugged into the [product_name] operator device, but the other end does not fit into the side of the analog output. The connector has six pins in a single row. Can anyone tell me what I'm doing incorrectly?

Hello, [user_name]. You need to apply pressure on the panel. The pressure parameters and connection method are specified on the underside of the panel or found in the manual. The analog input and output modules also require specific pressure.

If you are attempting to connect the cable from the [product_name] operator device to the analog module, that may be the issue. This cable should connect only to the central unit and not directly to the expansion modules. Check the [document] for further guidance.

The [product_name] operator device should be connected to the main [product_name] module, not to an expansion module. You will find the interface for the operator device on the left side of the [product_name] module, while expansion modules connect on the right. Hope this clarifies things.

Many people encounter this problem! The connector on the end of the [product_name] operator device resembles those on expansion modules with six pins in a row, and sometimes it even fits—though often upside down. For every [article_no] CPU, the left side has a removable cover hiding the correct interface for connecting the operator device cable. Once uncovered, the cable fits securely, with the pins oriented correctly. Picture attached for reference. If you found this reply helpful, consider using the rating feature. Have a great day!
[user_name] is correct; it's not the TD 200 but the [product_name] TD to use here. Nice new avatar! (Did it take you five days to paint?)

analysis.insight_summary: Users often mistake the connectors for the [product_name] operator device, attempting to connect it to expansion or analog output modules instead of the main module. Similar interfaces and unclear labeling result in frequent setup errors. Forum responses repeatedly highlight the prevalence of this issue and the need for improved guidance and documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate a straightforward and error-free process for connecting the [product_name] operator device, with compatible connectors and clear instructions that prevent misconnection or confusion.
